messages:
Sunil Rao: Hey everyone! Sunil here, starting today on Eng‑Platform. Quick intro: ex‑SaaS backend, hobbyist fountain‑pen collector, and tea person. A couple of quick setup questions and a tiny icebreaker — who should I ping for laptop imaging and VPN? Also, two truths & a lie at the end if anyone wants to play.

Maya (People Ops): Welcome, Sunil! :tada: You should get an email from MDM within 30–60m. If you don’t, DM me and I’ll chase IT. Onboarding checklist is here: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/new-hires — step 2 covers laptop pickup + shipping.

Aisha (Platform): Hi Sunil — I’m your official buddy this week, happy to walk through infra and runbooks. Ping me for a quick 30m sync. For SSH keys, drop your public key into the internal key manager and then run: `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa_redwood` once the host is approved.

Ben (Infra): VPN uses Okta + Duo. If you hit an MFA loop, try clearing cookies or use an incognito window. If you need immediate access for any infra tasks, tell Aisha and we’ll add you to the temporary group.

itbot: Device enrollment scheduled for Sunil Rao at 15:00 PST. Tracker: #ENROLL-9123. Reply `cancel` to this thread to reschedule.

Sunil Rao: Awesome, thanks. I just got the MDM invite — looks good. When should I expect org-level Slack channels (prod‑alerts, infra‑ops) to be available?

Aisha (Platform): Prod-alerts is by request — I’ll add you now so you can see the runbook pinned messages. infra‑ops requires a short just‑in‑time access approval for the first 48h; I’ll start that flow for you.

Juno (DevEx): Welcome! Two logistical notes: 1) Set up `gcloud`/`aws` creds after you’re on VPN, 2) Install the Redbot CLI if you plan on running local evals: `pip install redbot-client`. Also, coffee poll: what’s everyone’s go‑to? :coffee: :tea:

Sunil Rao: Answering the poll — tea in the afternoon, coffee to wake up. Two truths and a lie: 1) I once summited Kilimanjaro, 2) I collect rare fountain pens, 3) I shipped a bug that caused a major outage for 3 hours. Guess which one is the lie?

Ben (Infra): My bet is the Kilimanjaro one is the lie. Fountain pens feels very real. :smile:

Maya (People Ops): I think the outage one is the lie (fingers crossed!). Either way, love the pen hobby. We have a little sticker pack for collectors.

Aisha (Platform): Kilimanjaro is true — I remember a photo. So the outage was the lie? :eyes:

Sunil Rao: Plot twist — Kilimanjaro is true, fountain pens are true, the outage is the lie. Glad to be here and not famous for breaking prod. Looking forward to pairing with you all this week. Thanks for the quick responses!

Juno (DevEx): Nice. Welcome aboard — lunch chat later today? We’ll do a short meet-and-greet with the team at 1pm PT. I’ll post the Zoom link in #random.
